items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And you can see through that all the people who were centered right here ... Bill Robinson ... were all here

ctx.x: Chicago is still a good breeding ground.

Oh, this is a good breeding ground, and this is a good town, if they'd just let it be itself, like, Chicago has always been known. Because when we take all of the greats that have come out of Chicago here, -- I got some articles I want you to look at I wrote for the Chicago Defender. And this goes back to the early '20s, and all of this. And you can see through that all the people who were centered right here (recording interrupted) Bill Robinson, END T1 S2 P2 and you would have all the horn players like Joe…
Well, I know the name. I've never met him.
